newsitem.title: USA: Minnesota crops damaged by frost for a second week.
newsitem.headline: Minnesota crops damaged by frost for a second week.

text.p: Temperatures dropped into the 30s Farenheit in parts of Minnesota in the week ended Sunday, causing frost damage for a second straight week, the state's Agricultural Statistics Service said.
Corn rated good to excellent dropped five points in the week to 48 percent. Mature corn rose to 25 percent, up 16 points, but still lagged the 5-year average by 17 points.
Corn dented 96 pct vs 76 week ago, 98 year ago, 84 avg.
Corn harvested 1 pct vs nil w/a, 4 y/a, 2 avg.
Soybeans rated good to excellent dropped one point to 47 percent and soybeans generally lagged far behind averages.
Soybeans shedding leaves 49 pct vs 24 w/a, 73 y/a, 58 avg.
Soybeans mature 10 pct vs 3 w/a, 25 y/a, 22 avg.
Soybeans harvested 1 pct vs nil w/a, 3 y/a, 3 avg.
Spring wheat harvested 96 pct vs 85 w/a, 99 y/a, 90 avg.
Sugarbeets harvested 8 pct vs 5 w/a, 6 y/a, 8 avg.
Flaxseed harvested 23 pct vs 18 w/a, 32 y/a, 43 avg.
Rye seeded 74 pct vs 64 w/a, 69 y/a, 72 avg.
Winter wheat seeded 94 pct vs 83 w/a, 67 y/a, 73 avg.
